blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: In this paper we investigate the generalization capability of state-of-the-art object detection models (Hi-SAM, YOLO, and RT-DETR) for the automatic segmentation of text lines in historical documents. Generalization is needed because it is not practical for museums and archives to produce large amounts of labeled samples for each new collection. We also evaluate the few-shot setting by fine-tuning the networks with only a small number of training samples per target dataset. To this end, we use nine different datasets that differ significantly in visual layout and language. Additionally, we discuss why mean average precision (mAP), a classic evaluation metric for object detection, is insufficient for assessing the quality of a text line segmentation model. Depending on the dataset, our CRNN models achieve character error rates (CER) ranging from 2.48% to 7.07% per page for the segmented text lines. This is sufficient for reading comprehension and simple text searches. Finally, we quantify the resource and time requirements of training and inference in different use case settings. This forms the basis for more informed decisions about model and hardware choices based on available resources.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们调查了最先进的物体探测模型(Hi-SAM,YOLO,和RT-DETR)在历史文件中自动分割文本行的通用能力. 需要普遍化,因为博物馆和档案馆为每件新收藏品制作大量标签标本是不切实际的. 我们还通过微调每个目标数据集只有少量培训样本的网络,来评估几弹设定。 为此,我们使用了9个不同的数据集,在视觉布局和语言上差异很大. 此外,我们讨论了为什么平均精度(mAP)这个用于检测物体的经典评价指标不足以评估文本行分区模型的质量。 根据数据集的不同,我们的CRNN模型实现了字符错误率(CER),从2.48%到7.07%的每页分行文本. 这足以读取理解和简单的文本搜索。 最后,我们量化了不同使用情况下培训和推断的资源和时间要求。 这构成了根据现有资源就模型和硬件选择作出更知情决定的基础。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The automated recognition of digitized handwritten documents, particularly historical texts, remains a central research question and challenge in document analysis. One particular difficulty is not only the general state of preservation of historical documents, which can make them difficult to read for both humans and machines, but also the visual differences in handwriting, language, appearance and layout. These differ from modern versions in semantics and character sets and pose significant challenges for machine-based systems.
blocks.zh: 数字化手写文件的自动识别,特别是历史文本,仍然是文件分析中的一个中心研究问题和挑战. 一个特别的困难不仅是保存历史文献的一般状态,这可以使人类和机器都难以阅读,还有在笔迹,语言,外观和布局上的视觉差异. 这些在语义和字符集方面与现代版本不同,对以机器为基础的系统构成重大挑战.

blocks.en: Although recent research has focused on developing systems that combine layout analysis and text recognition for whole document pages Coquenet et al. (2023) , a multi-step process remains a dominant approach. This begins with the localization and segmentation of text lines in the page, after which the contents of each line are converted into digital text via a handwritten text recognition (HTR) model.
blocks.zh: 虽然最近的研究侧重于开发将整个文件页的版式分析和文本识别结合起来的系统 Coquenet等人(2023年),一个多步骤的过程仍然是主导方法。 这从页面中文本行的本地化和分化开始,之后每行的内容通过手写文本识别(HTR)模式被转换为数字文本.

blocks.en: There are several page level datasets researchers use for experiments. These generally have many pages of carefully labeled text zones and proofed textual content. These can be used to train or retrain a system to achieve a high quality recognition. When a library or archive is interested in digitizing and recognizing its contents, it wants to do so with as little careful zoning and transcription as possible. A set of tools is needed that has good performance as is, or that can be adapted with very few labeled pages.
blocks.zh: 有几页级数据集研究者用于实验. 这些图案一般有多页经过仔细标记的文字区和被校正的文字内容. 这些可以用来培训或再培训一个系统,以实现高质量的识别. 当一个图书馆或档案馆有兴趣将其内容数字化和识别时,它希望尽可能少小心地进行分区和抄写. 需要一套具有目前良好性能的工具,或可以用很少的标签页来调整的工具。

blocks.en: This raises the question of generalizability: Is it necessary to train new models for each new dataset? Could the information learned from established datasets be easily transferred to new ones? To what extent can trained "foundation" models generalize to unseen data in contexts that are comparable yet not identical to historical datasets?
blocks.zh: 这就提出了普遍性问题: 是否需要为每个新的数据集培训新的模型? 从已建立的数据集中获取的信息能否容易地转移到新的数据集? 在可比较但与历史数据集不完全相同的背景中,训练出"建立"模型可以在多大程度上概括到无形的数据?

blocks.en: To the best of our knowledge, no in-depth analysis of this issue for historical documents has yet been conducted. Hence, in our paper we aim to more closely analyze whether and to what extent text line detection models built from existing, well-established source datasets work for new target domains that differ significantly in terms of visual appearance and content. To this end, we evaluate three line detection methods: Hi-SAM – a model developed specifically for identifying elements in scene-text datasets containing printed and handwritten text in natural-image environments; and YOLO and RT-DETR – methods that have generally delivered robust results for detecting elements in images. We consider their direct generalizability to new document datasets, and then evaluate how retraining with a small portion of a new dataset affects their performance. We further explore the usefulness of the mean average precision (mAP) evaluation metric, typically used with detection networks, for assessing the quality of text line segmentation networks with the downstream task of HTR in mind.
blocks.zh: 据我们所知,迄今没有为历史文献深入分析这一问题。 因此,在我们的文件中,我们的目标是更仔细地分析现有、公认的源数据集所建的文本行检测模型是否和在多大程度上适用于视觉外观和内容相差很大的新的目标领域。 为此,我们评价了三种线上检测方法: Hi-SAM – 一个专门为识别场景文本数据集中包含自然图像环境中印刷和手写文本的元素而开发的模型;和 YOLO 和 RT-DETR – 通常在图像中检测元素产生强效结果的方法. 我们认为它们可以直接概括到新的文件数据集,然后评估使用一小部分新数据集的再培训如何影响其性能。 我们进一步探讨平均精确度(mAP)评价尺度(通常用于检测网络)对评估文本行分解网络的质量是否有用,同时考虑到HTR的下游任务。

blocks.en:
Modern line segmentation models can be large and computationally expensive. This is another challenge for institutions like archives and libraries who usually will not have access to large supercomputing networks.
Therefore, we further report the memory and compute needed to train and do inference with these models and provide an overview of the necessary resources, including RAM, training time, and inference time, for different use cases, ranging from a regular laptop without a dedicated GPU to a high-performance cluster designed for machine learning tasks.
blocks.zh:
现代的分线模型可能很大,计算成本也很高. 这是档案和图书馆等机构面临的又一挑战,这些机构通常无法进入大型超级计算网络。
因此,我们进一步报告培训和推断这些模型所需的内存和计算,并概述各种使用案例的必要资源,包括记录和档案管理、培训时间和推断时间,从没有专用GPU的普通笔记本电脑到为机器学习任务设计的高性能集群。

blocks.en: Hence, the contributions of our paper are as follows:
blocks.zh: 因此,我们的文件的贡献如下:

blocks.en: • a study on the generalization capability of established object detectors for the purpose of text line segmentation, evaluated on multiple varying target datasets, • a detailed view into standard evaluation metrics for text line segmentation with respect to the downstream end goal of text recognition, • an analysis of the impact of finetuning pretrained networks on small numbers of pages per target domain, • an overview of computational and data requirements for producing competitive results in low-resource scenarios.

Section 3 describes the datasets used in this work, the segmentation and recognition models and metrics as well as the experimental setup. The corresponding results are detailed in Section 4 . An in-depth discussion on the results is conducted in Section 5 , with conclusions in Section 6 .

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Numerous methods have been proposed to detect and delineate text lines in document images. Traditional approaches often rely on structural assumptions, such as text being predominantly horizontal and straight, and the presence of visible gaps between adjacent lines where the lighter background separates darker ink regions.
Classical line segmentation techniques include adaptive partial projection, matched filtering, midpoint detection, thinning-based methods, second-order derivative analysis, and path-finding approaches. These techniques generally rely on handcrafted heuristics and structural assumptions regarding text alignment, baseline regularity, and inter-line spacing and require careful parameter tuning to handle complex scripts and degraded manuscripts Likforman-Sulem et al. (2007) ; Ratheash and Sathik (2019) .
blocks.zh:
提出了许多方法来探测和划分文件图像中的文字行。 传统方法往往依赖于结构假设,例如文字主要是横向和直线的,相邻行间存在明显的空白,而相邻行间较轻的背景将更深的墨水区域相分离.
古典线分解技术包括适应性局部投影,相匹配的滤波,中点检测,以稀薄为主的方法,二阶衍生物分析,以及路径调查方法等. 这些技术一般依赖手制的关于文本对接、基线正则性和行间间隔的heuristics和结构假设,并需要谨慎地进行参数调整,以处理复杂的脚本和已退化的手稿Likforman-Sulem等人(2007年);Ratheash和Sathik(2019年)。

blocks.en: Although such classical techniques remain computationally efficient and interpretable, their robustness is often limited when confronted with irregular baselines, variable ascender and descender lengths, and characters overlapping across neighboring lines. Historical documents further introduce challenges such as background degradation, yellowing, and bleed-through artifacts, which complicate reliable line separation. As a result, the robustness of rule-based techniques is limited when confronted with such variability.
blocks.zh: 虽然这种古典技术在计算上仍然有效率并可以解释,但是当遇到不规则的基线,可变的升起和下起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起起 历史文献进一步提出了背景退化,黄化,出血等难题,使可靠线条分离复杂化. 因此,在面对这种可变性时,基于规则的技术的稳健性是有限的。

blocks.en:
To address these limitations, recent research predominantly uses machine learning-based methods which are data-driven and rely on learned representations from annotated data rather than handcrafted structural assumptions Boillet et al. (2022) ; Rabaev and Litvak (2026) .
These are therefore better suited to handle diverse document characteristics. In this work, we investigate several modern architectures, including general-purpose instance segmentation models, object detection frameworks, and a model specifically designed for modern text-line segmentation.
blocks.zh:
为了克服这些局限性,最近的研究主要采用基于机器的学习方法,这些方法以数据为动力,依靠的是附加说明的数据中吸取的教训,而不是人工制作的结构假设Boillet等人(2022年);Rabaev和Litvak(2026年)。
因此,它们更适合处理各种文件特性。 在这项工作中,我们调查了几种现代建筑,包括通用实例分解模型,对象检测框架,以及专门为现代文本行分解设计的模型.

blocks.en: Hi-SAM Ye et al. (2024) , a transformer-based architecture designed for word, text-line, and paragraph-level segmentation. The model builds upon the Segment Anything Model (SAM) Kirillov et al. (2023) , which typically requires user-provided prompts to guide segmentation. To eliminate this dependency, Hi-SAM incorporates a self-prompting mechanism that automatically generates prompts for relevant regions of interest.
blocks.zh: 嗨,萨姆 Ye et al. (2024),一种以变压器为主的建筑,以文字,文字行为主,并分出段落. 该模型以分块任意模式(SAM)Kirillov等(2023)为基础,通常需要用户提供的提示来指导分块. 为了消除这种依赖性,Hi-SAM采用了一种自动为相关区域产生提示的自我提示机制。

blocks.en: You Only Look Once (YOLO) 1 1 1 https://docs.ultralytics.com/models/ , last accessed 26 May 2026. is a real-time object detection framework that can be adapted for text line localization by predicting bounding boxes or segmentation masks. Versions, starting with YOLOv8, which support instance segmentation, enable pixel-level delineation of text regions instead of relying on rectangular bounding boxes. This is particularly beneficial for overlapping lines, non-horizontal layouts, and curved text-lines.
blocks.zh: You Only Look Once(YOLO) 1 1 https://docs.ultralytics.com/models/,上回访问2026年5月26日. 是一个实时对象检测框架,可以通过预测边框或分块口罩来适应文本行本地化. 版本,从支持实例分割的YOLOv8开始,可以像素水平地划定文本区域,而不是依赖长方形边框. 这对重叠行,非横向布局,和曲折的文本行特别有利.

blocks.en: RT-DETR Zhao et al. (2024) is an end-to-end, transformer-based real-time object detection framework that removes the reliance on Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS) enabling it to achieve superior performance compared to YOLO-based detectors in real-time settings. The model architecture comprises an efficient hybrid encoder coupled with a transformer decoder enhanced by auxiliary prediction heads.
blocks.zh: RT-DETR 软件 Zhao 等 (2024)是一款端到端,变压器的实时对象检测框架,可以去除对Non-Maximum Present (NMS)的依赖,使其能够在实时环境下实现优于YOLO的检测器的性能. 模型架构由高效的混合编码器和由辅助预测头增强的变压器解码器组成.

blocks.en: Despite their strong performance on benchmark datasets, the cross-dataset generalization of these architectures for handwritten document analysis remains insufficiently studied. In particular, the relationship between detection metrics and downstream recognition performance has not been systematically examined. In this work, we address this gap by evaluating YOLOv8, Hi-SAM, and RT-DETR under domain shifts and assess segmentation quality using both detection and recognition-based metrics.
blocks.zh: 尽管这些结构在基准数据集方面表现良好,但用于手写文件分析的这些结构的跨数据集通论仍然没有得到充分研究。 特别是,检测指标与下游识别性能之间的关系没有得到系统的审查. 在这项工作中,我们通过对YOLOv8、Hi-SAM和RT-DETR进行域位转移的评估,并使用检测和基于识别的尺度评估分化质量,来弥补这一差距。

blocks.en: The first training dataset is part of an extensive collection of Norwegian manuscripts, NorHand v3 Beyer and Solberg (2023) . It includes letters and diaries from the 19th and early 20th centuries. Most pages exhibit yellowish or brownish discoloration. Bleed-through occurs but is not problematic here. In contrast, the handwriting shows significant variance. Within the original dataset, individual books can be identified by numerical prefixes. We use book 331861 as a training dataset.
blocks.zh: 第一套培训数据集是挪威手稿"NorHand v3 Beyer"和"Solberg"(2023年)广泛收集的一部分. 它包括19世纪和20世纪初的来信和日记. 大部分页面呈现出黄色或棕色的去色. 血流成河 但这里没有问题 相比之下,笔迹显示差异很大。 在原始数据集中,可以通过数字前缀识别出单个账簿. 我们用"331861"作为训练数据集.

blocks.en: READ 2016 Sanchez et al. (2016) is a subset of pages collected from Ratsprotokolle’s council minutes from the 15th to the 19th century. The documents also exhibit slight yellowish discoloration. The handwriting features sweeping, elongated letters, particularly at the start of paragraphs and in headings. Bleed-through, or text showing through from the other side of the page, poses an additional challenge.
blocks.zh: READ 2016 Sanchez等人(2016年)是从Ratsprotokolle的15至19世纪议会会议记录中收集的一分页. 这些文件也呈现出略为黄色的去色. 笔迹突出的是横跨的字母,特别是在段落开头和标题中。 Bleed-over,或从页面的另一边显示的文本,构成额外的挑战.

blocks.en: The Nuremberg LB 3 is drawn from a dataset of German-language documents dating from the early fifteenth century. Although we limited ourselves to the third volume to closely match the number of pages to the READ 2016 dataset, the original dataset Mayr et al. (2025) comprises a total of four books. The pages of these documents are less yellowed than those in READ. Most striking, however, is the highly ornate, rounded style of the handwriting.
blocks.zh: 纽伦堡LB 3取自自自15世纪早期的德语文档数据集. 虽然我们把自己限制在第三卷,以紧密地与READ 2016数据集的页数相匹配,但原始数据集Mayr等. (2025年)共由四本书组成. 这些文件的页面比READ中的小. 然而,最出人意料的是笔迹的高端圆形风格.

blocks.en: We hypothesized that a more diverse dataset might be better suited for training a foundation model. For this reason, we introduced an additional Mix dataset consisting of one-third each of the three previously described training datasets.

blocks.en: 3.2 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 3.2 评价计量

blocks.en: We use mean average precision (mAP) as a metric to evaluate the performance of our object detection networks. It is defined as m ​ A ​ P = 1 n ​ ∑ i = 1 n A ​ P i mAP=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}AP_{i} where A ​ P i AP_{i} is the average precision for class i i (in our case, n = 1 n=1 as we are only predicting text lines). The average precision is defined as the area under the precision-recall-curve. To define the alignment of predictions and ground-truth (GT) annotations, an Intersection over Union (IoU) threshold is determined. We compute the m A P 50 : 95 mAP_{50:95} metric, which takes the average for all IoU thresholds from 0.50 to 0.95 in incremental steps of step width 0.05. The higher this value, the closer the alignment of predictions and GT boxes.
blocks.zh: 我们使用平均精度(mAP)作为度量,来评价我们物体检测网络的性能. 它被定义为: m A P = 1 n = i = 1 n A P i = frac{ 1 }{ }\ }\ sum_{i = 1}^{n} } A _{i}i},其中 A P i AP_{i}是I类(在我们的情况下,n = 1 n = 1)的平均精度,因为我们只是预测文本行. 平均精度被定义为精度回调曲线下的区域. 为了确定预测和地面真实性说明的一致性,确定了一个跨联盟(IoU)的交叉阈值。 我们计算出 m A P 50 : 95 mAP = 50: 95 } 度量,它将所有IOU阈值的平均值从0.50到0.95的渐入步宽0.05。 这一值越高,预测和GT框的对接就越接近.

blocks.en: While mAP is commonly used to evaluate object detection models, we ultimately have text recognition in mind as the downstream task. Therefore, the quality of the recognition results is equally important, as we need to ensure that the predicted text line boxes provide suitable input for the HTR system to extract the text effectively.
blocks.zh: 虽然mAP通常用于评估对象检测模型,但我们最终将文本识别作为下游任务来考虑. 因此,识别结果的质量同样重要,因为我们需要确保预测的文本行框为HTR系统提供合适的输入来有效取出文本.

blocks.en: We evaluate the quality of HTR with the Character Error Rate (CER): C ​ E ​ R = S + I + D N , CER=\frac{S+I+D}{N}, (1)
blocks.zh: 我们用字符出错率(CER)评价HTR的质量:C E R = S + I + D N, CER=\frac{S+I+D}{N}, (1) 国家

blocks.en: which is based on the Levenshtein edit distance Yujian and Bo (2007) . CER quantifies the number of character-level operations required to transform the predicted text into the ground-truth. It is computed as the ratio of the total number of substitutions (S), insertions (I), and deletions (D) edits to the number of characters (N) in the ground-truth. Lower CER values indicate better recognition performance, reflecting fewer discrepancies between the predicted and reference text.
blocks.zh: 以Levenshtein编辑距离为主, CER 量化将预测文本转化为地真相所需的字符级操作数量. 它按替换(S)、插入(I)和删除(D)的总数与地面真实的字符数(N)的比率来计算。 CER数值较低表明识别性能较好,反映出预测文本和参考文本之间的差异较少。

blocks.en: To compute the CER for the predicted text lines, the corresponding ground-truth text must first be identified. Since the predicted bounding boxes are not guaranteed to follow the top-to-bottom reading order and some lines are not detected, we match the predicted boxes to the ground-truth boxes by first computing the IoU between them and then applying the Hungarian search algorithm to obtain the optimal assignment. This matching enables accurate line-level CER computation. The edit distance is computed for each matched line pair. The standard CER penalties for insertions and deletions are also applied when the number of predicted boxes differs from the number of ground-truth boxes, accounting for extra or missing detections. Finally, the edit distances are accumulated over all lines and pages in the split and then normalized by the total number of characters N N .
blocks.zh: 为计算预测文本行的CER,必须首先确定相应的地-真实文本。 由于预测的边框不能保证遵循从上到下读取的顺序,而且一些行没有被检测出,所以我们首先通过计算它们之间的IoU,然后应用匈牙利的搜索算法来获得最佳任务,将预测的边框与地上真实的相匹配. 这种匹配可进行精确的行级CER计算. 为每对匹配的行对计算编辑距离。 如果预测的箱数与地面真实箱数不同,计入额外或缺失的检测,则适用关于插入和删除的标准CER处罚. 最后,编辑距离是在分页中所有行和页上累积的,然后由字符总数N N 正常化.

blocks.en: 3.3 Text Line Detection Models
blocks.zh: 3.3 文本行检测模型

blocks.en: Hi-SAM . We used the Hi-SAM model introduced in Ye et al. (2024) and adopted the official PyTorch implementation. The authors released three model variants (base, large, and huge). Based on our preliminary experiments, the huge variant (H) provided the best performance for text-line segmentation, therefore, we used it in this work. The model has five modules: an image encoder, a pixel-level mask decoder, and frozen prompt encoder derived from SAM Kirillov et al. (2023) , a self prompt module, and a hierarchical mask decoder. They included trainable adapters to the two Vision Transformer (ViT) blocks in the encoder but kept the encoder frozen.
blocks.zh: 嗨,萨姆。 我们使用Ye等(2024年)引入的Hi-SAM模型,并采用了PyTorch正式实施. 作者发布了三个模型变体(基,大和大). 根据我们的初步实验,巨大的变体(H)为文本行分解提供了最佳的性能,因此,我们在这项工作中使用了它. 该模型有五个模块:一个图像编码器,一个像素级口罩解码器,以及从SAM Kirillov等(2023年)衍生出来的被冻结的即时编码器,一个自快模块,以及一个分级口罩解码器. 其中包括了可被训练的可适配器以适应编码器中两个"ViT"变形器(ViT)块而使编码器保持了冻结.

blocks.en: YOLO . You Only Look Once (YOLO) is a well-established family of one-shot object detection models, nowadays also used for detecting and localizing entities in handwritten documents, such as individual characters. New models with incremental version numbers are constantly being released, but they do not necessarily represent direct improvements in HTR. Rather, they demonstrate various approaches and model architectures within the one-shot YOLO framework. Additionally, newer YOLO architectures have advanced capabilities, such as instance segmentation and oriented box detection. After testing various versions and variants in a preliminary experimental study, this paper focuses on the version with the best test results: YOLO8-l-seg, a YOLO8 Varghese and M. (2024) variant designed for instance segmentation tasks. We use the implementation provided by Ultralytics 4 4 4 https://docs.ultralytics.com/models/yolov8 , last accessed 26 May 2026. .
blocks.zh: 尤罗。 You Only Look Once(YOLO)是一个由一发物体探测模型组成的成熟家族,如今也被用于在手写文档中检测和定位实体,例如单个字符. 带有增量版号的新模型不断被发布,但它们并不一定代表了HTR的直接改进. 相反,它们展示的是一发一发的YOLO框架内的各种方法和模式架构。 此外,较新的YOLO架构具有先进的能力,如实例分解和取向箱检测等. 本文在初步实验研究中测试了各种版本和变体后,重点介绍具有最佳测试结果的版本: YOLO8-l-seg,一种YOLO8 Varghese和M. (2024)等变体,以分区任务为例被设计. 我们使用Ultralytics 4 4 4 https://docs.ultralytics.com/models/yolov8提供的执行情况,最近一次访问是2026年5月26日.

blocks.en: RT-DETR . In terms of speed and efficiency, transformer-based detectors (DETRs) have lagged behind other detectors, such as those in the YOLO family. This is important not only for real-time applications but also for the detection of text lines in a large archive with many document pages, which benefits significantly from fast results. For this reason, we also tested RT-DETR Zhao et al. (2024) , which, thanks to changes in its architecture, is supposed to keep up with YOLO models. RT-DETR is an object detection network only, hence it produces bounding boxes instead of fine-grained segmentation masks. Again, we are using the "large" sized implementation by Ultralytics 5 5 5 https://docs.ultralytics.com/models/rtdetr , last accessed 26 May 2026. .
blocks.zh: RT-DETR (中文(简体) ). 在速度和效率方面,以变压器为基础的探测器(DETRs)已经落后于其他探测器,如YOLO家族的探测器. 这不仅对实时应用很重要,而且对在有大量文件页的大型档案中检测出文本行也十分重要,快速结果可大大受益. 出于这个原因,我们还测试了RT-DETR Zhao等 (2024年),由于建筑结构的变化,应该能跟得上YOLO模型. RT-DETR仅是一个物体检测网络,因此它生产出有边框,而不是精细的分片口罩. 使用Ultralytics 5 5 5 5 https://docs.

blocks.en: 3.4 HTR CRNN Model
blocks.zh: 3.4 HTR CRNN模型

blocks.en:
State-of-the-art (SOTA) HTR architectures that do not rely on massive pre-training datasets are still predominantly based on CRNN models. The authors in Corbillé and Barney Smith (2025) introduced a center-loss-based CRNN architecture that achieves SOTA performance. Although the center-loss formulation improves recognition performance, it also increases the training complexity and time.
In this work, we use the CRNN-based HTR architecture proposed in Retsinas et al. (2022) , which is lightweight architecturally similar to Corbillé and Barney Smith (2025) but does not incorporate the center-loss objective. It remains competitive on the IAM dataset while being simpler to train.
blocks.zh:
不依赖大规模预训数据集的一流(SOTA)HTR架构仍然以CRNN模型为主. Corbillé和Barney Smith (2025)的作者引入了以Centre-loss为基础的CRNN架构,实现了SOTA的性能. 虽然"中心损失"的配方提高了识别性能,但也增加了培训的复杂性和时间.
在这部作品中,我们采用了Retsinas等(2022年)中提议的以CRNN为基础的HTR架构,其轻量级建筑与Corbillé和Barney Smith(2025年)相似,但没有纳入中损目标. 它在IAM数据集上仍然具有竞争力,同时更便于训练.

blocks.en: The CRNN-based HTR architecture proposed in Retsinas et al. (2022) begins with a 7 × 7 7\times 7 convolutional layer with 32 output channels, followed by a sequence of ResNet blocks. Specifically, the network contains two ResNet blocks with 64 output channels, four blocks with 128 channels, and four with 256 channels. Column-wise max pooling is then applied to aggregate the spatial features. The recurrent module consists of three Bi-LSTM layers with a hidden dimension of 256.
blocks.zh: Retsinas等提出了基于CRNN的HTR架构. (2022年)起先为7×7 7\times 7相变相层,有32个输出通道,后为ResNet块序. 具体而言,网络包含两个ResNet区块,有64个输出频道,4个区块有128个频道,4个区块有256个频道. 然后采用列最大集合来汇总空间特征。 经常模块由3个Bi-LSTM层组成,隐藏维度为256.

blocks.en: 3.5 Text Line Segmentation Training Protocol
blocks.zh: 3.5 文本行分区培训协议

blocks.en: First, we train all three methods on the four training datasets and evaluate their segmentation performance in-domain. We test zero-shot out-of-domain on the remaining six datasets to determine their generalization capability.
blocks.zh: 首先,我们在四个培训数据集上培训所有三种方法,并评价其域内分解性能. 我们在剩下的六个数据集上测试零射出域,以确定它们的通缩能力.

blocks.en: In the second phase, we evaluate few-shot learning by adding a small number of target-domain samples to improve line detector performance and assess sensitivity to limited target-domain data.
blocks.zh: 在第二阶段,我们通过增加少量的目标域样本来评价几发学习,以提高行探测器的性能并评估对有限的目标域数据的敏感性.

blocks.en: Hi-SAM was trained with 6x A100 40GB GPUs with a batch size of 1 and an initial learning rate (LR) of 1e-4, which was reduced to 1e-5 after a patience of 200 epochs. Following the learning rate reduction, early stopping was applied with an additional patience of 200 epochs. We adopted the original data augmentation strategy used for Hi-SAM, but limited the maximum random rotation to 20 ∘ . Training Hi-SAM requires document images, polygon annotations for text lines, and corresponding binary masks. Although Hi-SAM is capable of generating the necessary binary masks, it is sensitive to bleed-through text. Therefore, we produce Otsu Otsu and others (1975) -based binary masks and combine them with the masks produced by Hi-SAM and subsequently remove background regions not covered by the ground-truth line polygons.
blocks.zh: Hi-SAM通过6x A100 40GB GPU进行训练,批量尺寸为1,初始学习率(LR)为1e-4,经过200个纪元的耐心后被减为1e-5. 学习率降低后,提前停课,加耐心200个纪元. 我们采用了用于Hi-SAM的原始数据增强策略,但将最大随机旋转限制在20 QQ. 培训 Hi-SAM需要文档图像,文本行的多边形说明,以及相应的二进制口罩. 虽然Hi-SAM能够生成必要的二进制口罩,但对于出血穿行的文字很敏感. 因此,我们生产出Otsu Otsu等(1975年)-基于二进制口罩,并将其与Hi-SAM生产的口罩相结合,并随后去除地-真线多边形未覆盖的背景区域.

blocks.en: Both YOLOv8 and RT-DETR were trained for up to 5,000 epochs with early stopping (patience = 250) using the MuSGD optimizer (LR 0.01, momentum 0.9), batch size of 8, and an input size of 1280 × 1280 pixels.
blocks.zh: YOLOv8和RT-DETR都曾被训练到可达5000个时段,使用MuSGD优化器(LR 0.01,动力为0.9)早期停止(patience = 250),分批大小为8个,输入大小为1280×1280像素.

blocks.en: To ensure a fair comparison, Hi-SAM was initialized using SAM pre-trained weights derived from natural-image training, whereas YOLO and RT-DETR were initialized using weights pre-trained on the COCO dataset. As RT-DETR produces only bounding-box predictions, the segmentation masks generated by Hi-SAM and YOLO are converted into bounding boxes to enable a consistent comparison across models.
blocks.zh: 为确保公平比较,Hi-SAM采用自然成像训练产生的SAM预训加权来初始化,而YOLO和RT-DETR则采用CO数据集预训加权来初始化. 由于RT-DETR只产生边框预测,由Hi-SAM和YOLO所生成的分块口罩被转换为边框来进行跨模型的一致比较.

blocks.en: We observed that RT-DETR creates an extensive amount of overlapping predictions. To mitigate this issue, we apply additional NMS as a post-processing step to remove redundant detections at inference.
blocks.zh: 我们注意到,RT-DETR产生大量重叠预测。 为了缓解这个问题,我们采用了额外的NMS作为后处理步骤来去除推论中多余的检测.

blocks.en: The optimal confidence and NMS thresholds for YOLO and RT-DETR, as well as the optimal score and NMS thresholds for Hi-SAM, were identified through a grid search that we performed on the source-domain validation set.
blocks.zh: YOLO和RT-DETR的最佳置信度和NMS阈值,以及Hi-SAM的最佳分数和NMS阈值,是通过我们在源域验证集上进行的网格搜索确定的.

blocks.en: For few-shot learning, we created two training sub-splits from each target dataset: one containing 10 sample pages and another containing 50 sample pages, where the 10-page split is a subset of the 50-page split. During training, only the selected few-shot samples were used as training data, while the full validation set of the target dataset was used for model selection.
blocks.zh: 为了几发学习,我们从每个目标数据集中创建了两个训练分集:一个包含10个样本页,另一个包含50个样本页,其中10页分集是50页分集的子集. 在培训期间,只有所选取的几发样本被用作培训数据,而目标数据集的完整验证集则用于模型选择.

blocks.en: The total number of training epochs for Hi-SAM was limited to 300. Fine-tuning was performed with an initial learning rate of 1e-4, which was reduced to 1e-5 after 250 epochs. All experiments were conducted using a single NVIDIA A100 GPU. Both YOLO and RT-DETR were trained a total of 8,000 epochs without early stopping and we picked the best model based on the validation mAP. The training was conducted with an AdamW optimizer with an initial learning rate of 0.002 and a momentum of 0.9. Both training and fine-tuning used a single A100 GPU.
blocks.zh: Hi-SAM的培训时代总数被限制在300个. 进行了精细调整,初始学习率为1e-4,250个纪元后降至1e-5. 所有实验都使用一个单一的NVIDIA A100 GPU进行. YOLO和RT-DETR都接受了8000个世纪的训练,没有提前停止,我们根据验证的mAP选择了最好的模型. 培训采用AdamW优化器,初始学习率为0.002,势头为0.9。 训练与微调均使用一款A100GPU.

blocks.en: 3.6 HTR Training Protocol
blocks.zh: 3.6 HTR培训议定书

blocks.en:
For each dataset, we train a CRNN HTR model using text lines obtained from the ground-truth bounding boxes together with their corresponding transcriptions.
The CRNN models are trained using the Adam optimizer with a batch size of 32 and a learning rate of 5e-4. The training is conducted for 1,500 total epochs. The learning rate is reduced to 5e-5 with a patience of 100 and early stopping is applied with a patience of 200 after the learning rate drop.
blocks.zh:
对于每个数据集,我们使用从地面-真值框中取出的案文行及其相应的抄本,培训一个CRNN HTR模型。
CRNN模型使用亚当优化器进行训练,分批大小为32个,学习率为5e-4. 培训共为1 500个世纪。 学习率被降低到5e-5,有100个耐心,在学习率下降后提前停止,有200个耐心。

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Quantitative Evaluation of Line Segmentation
blocks.zh: 4.1 对分界线进行定量评价

blocks.en: This section presents the quantitative evaluation of the trained line segmentation models. We report performance using mAP, which measures how accurately the predicted bounding boxes align with the ground-truth line annotations.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍经过培训的分界线模型的数量评估。 我们使用mAP来报告业绩,它衡量预测的边框与地面真实行说明的准确性。

blocks.en: Table 2: Cross-dataset evaluation of three line detectors trained on four datasets and tested on nine datasets. Performance is reported as mAP, where higher value is better.
blocks.zh: 表2:对3个线上探测器进行跨数据集评价,经过4个数据集培训,并经过9个数据集的测试. 性能报告为mAP,其中较高值更好.

blocks.en:
We trained the three line segmentation models described in Section 3.3 on the four training datasets: NorHand-331861, READ 2016, Nuremberg LB 3, and the Mix dataset. After that, we evaluated their performance on all nine datasets described in Section 3.1 and report the results in Table 2 . As would be expected, the models generally perform best in the in-domain setting (shaded).
Hi-SAM and YOLO achieved higher performance than RT-DETR.
blocks.zh:
我们培训了第3.3节所描述的关于四个训练数据集的三行分块模型:NorHand-331861,READ 2016,纽伦堡LB 3和Mix数据集. 之后,我们评价了它们在第3.1节所述所有9个数据集上的业绩,并在表2中报告了结果。 如所预期,这些模型一般在域内环境中表现最好(阴影)。
Hi-SAM和YOLO取得了比RT-DETR更高的性能.

blocks.en: For the out-of-domain (OOD) setting (not shaded), we evaluate the generalizability of the line detectors by training the model on one dataset and testing on the remaining eight datasets, excluding the training dataset. For the Mix dataset, we consider only six test datasets. As shown in Table 2 , when Hi-SAM is trained on NorHand-331861, READ 2016, or Nuremberg LB 3 and evaluated on out-of-domain datasets, the mAP values are below 50% in most cases. Only two out of 24 out-of-domain evaluations achieve a mAP above 60%, both when Hi-SAM is trained on NorHand-331861 and tested on Riksarkivet BK 1 & 2, suggesting limited but dataset-dependent generalization.
blocks.zh: 关于域外(OO)设置(不是遮蔽),我们通过培训一个数据集的模型和测试其余8个数据集(不包括培训数据集),来评价线道探测器的通用性. 对于Mix数据集,我们只考虑6个测试数据集. 如表2所显示,当Hi-SAM在NorHand-331861,READ 2016,或纽伦堡LB 3上接受训练并在域外数据集上评价时,大多数情况下mAP值低于50%. 在24个域外评价中,只有2个实现了60%以上的mAP,这时Hi-SAM在NorHand-331861上接受了培训,并在Riksarkivet BK 1 & 2上进行了测试,这表明了有限但依赖数据集的概括.

blocks.en: YOLO follows a similar trend, with only the same two cases achieving a mAP above 70%. Hi-SAM outperforms YOLO in most OOD settings. The only exceptions were five cases: when YOLO was trained on NorHand-331861 and evaluated on Riksarkivet BK 1 & 2, and Riksarkivet GBG 1 & 2; and when YOLO was trained on Nuremberg LB 3 and evaluated on Riksarkivet BK 1. For RT-DETR, all OOD cases achieved a mAP below 50%.
blocks.zh: YOLO也呈现出类似的趋势,只有两个案例的mAP达到70%以上. Hi-SAM在大多数OD环境下的优于YOLO. 唯一的例外是5个案例:YOLO在NorHand-331861上接受了培训,在Riksarkivet BK 1 & 2和Riksarkivet GBG 1 & 2上接受了评估;YOLO在纽伦堡LB 3上接受了培训,在Riksarkivet BK 1上接受了评估. 对RT-DETR来说,所有OD病例都实现了低于50%的mAP.

blocks.en: We then trained the models on the Mix dataset to improve domain generalizability. In this setting, only six datasets were considered out-of-domain, since the Mix dataset includes training samples from NorHand-331861, READ 2016, and Nuremberg LB 3. As shown in Table 2 , only YOLO achieved a mAP above 60% when evaluated on the Riksarkivet BK 2 and Riksarkivet GBG 1 datasets.
blocks.zh: 我们随后对Mix数据集的模型进行了培训,以提高域可通用性. 在此设定中,只有6个数据集被认为是域外数据集,因为Mix数据集包括来自NorHand-331861,READ 2016,和纽伦堡LB 3.的培训样本. 如表2所示,在Riksarkivet BK 2和Riksarkivet GBG 1数据集上评价时,只有YOLO实现了高于60%的mAP.

blocks.en: Overall, these results indicate that all three models do not generalize robustly for text line segmentation across unseen datasets.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,这些结果表明,所有三种模型都无法在不见的数据集中对文本行分解进行有力的概括。

blocks.en: 4.2 Qualitative Evaluation of Line Segmentation
blocks.zh: 4.2 线条分割定性评价.

blocks.en: We conducted a qualitative analysis to further validate the quantitative results discussed above. All models in Table 2 generally achieved low mAP scores, indicating limited cross-domain generalization. However, the qualitative results in Figure 2 show that model behavior varies across datasets. In particular, the Hi-SAM predictions, shown in the second row, align more closely with the ground-truth bounding boxes shown in the first row. YOLO and RT-DETR failed to segment text lines accurately in most cases, highlighting that not all line detection models are equally poor in terms of qualitative segmentation performance.

blocks.en: 4.3 Investigation into mAP as Evaluation Metric
blocks.zh: 4.3 对作为评价计量的mAP的调查

blocks.en: To better understand the discrepancy between the qualitative and quantitative results, we examined the mAP calculation procedure. mAP is computed by first measuring the Intersection over Union (IoU) between each predicted bounding box and its corresponding ground-truth box. A set of IoU thresholds is then applied, as described in Section 3.2 , to classify detections as true positives or false positives. However, for a given IoU threshold, there are two possible outcomes for each predicted bounding box. For example, as illustrated in Figure 3 , a prediction that covers only half of the ground-truth region (case 1) has an IoU measure of 0.5, but is clearly insufficient for line level HTR and may result in increased CER. Conversely, a prediction that slightly extends beyond the ground-truth boundaries on all four sides (case 2) can also achieve an IoU of 0.5 while having minimal impact on HTR performance and only marginally affecting the CER as the predicted box covers the full text line. Therefore, even when mAP values are low, the predicted bounding boxes may still be adequate for downstream HTR tasks, highlighting a limitation when relying solely on IoU-based detection metrics.
blocks.zh: 为了更好地了解质量结果和数量结果之间的差异,我们审查了mAP计算程序。 mAP通过首先测量每个预测的边框与其相应的地-真框之间的连接(IoU)来计算. 然后适用一套IoU阈值,如第3.2节所描述的那样,将检测结果归类为真阳性或假阳性. 然而,对于给定的IoU阈值,每个预测的边框都有两种可能的结果. 例如,如图3所说明的,仅涵盖地表真实区域一半的预测(例1)的IoU度量为0.5,但显然不足以表示线级HTR,可能导致CER增加。 反之,在四面略为超出地面真实界限的预测(情况2)也可实现0.5的IoU,同时对HTR性能影响最小,而且对CER的影响很小,因为预测的框覆盖了全文行. 因此,即使在mAP值很低的情况下,预测的边框仍然可以胜任下游的HTR任务,在完全依赖IoU检测度量表时凸显出一个局限性.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Two ways IoU 0.5 overlap can occur. The blue box is the ground-truth bounding box. The red box is the predicted bounding box.
blocks.zh: 图3:IoU 0.5重叠的两种方式。 蓝色的盒子是地面真实的边界盒子。 红色盒子是预测的边框.

blocks.en: 4.4 Quantitative Evaluation of Recognition
blocks.zh: 4.4 对承认的定量评估

blocks.en: Table 3: Cross-dataset evaluation of three line detectors trained on four datasets and tested on 9 datasets. Performance is reported as CER%, where lower values indicate better performance.
blocks.zh: 表3:对3个线道探测器进行跨数据集评价,经过4个数据集培训,在9个数据集上进行测试. 业绩报告为CER%,其中数值较低表明业绩较好。

blocks.en: We used the same bounding boxes generated by the three line detectors that were used to calculate the mAP in Table 2 , and now recognize the text content using the CRNN HTR model presented in Section 3.4 . We calculate the CER and present the results in Table 3 . The top row of Table 3 presents the baseline CER values when the HTR model is trained with "optimum" text lines from the GT bounding boxes and evaluated on the GT testing split of each dataset.
blocks.zh: 我们使用三个行检测器生成的相同边框,用于计算表2中的mAP,现在使用第3.4节中介绍的CRNN HTR模型识别文字内容。 我们计算CER并在表3中列出结果。 表3上行列出基准CER值,当HTR模型被从GT边框中以"优化"的文字行来训练,并在每个数据集的GT测试分出时进行评价.

blocks.en: For the in-domain case, when the models are trained and tested with the test split from the same document collection, the CER results (Table 3 shaded) are very close to the baseline with text line boxes from Hi-SAM and YOLO giving a maximum gap of 0.56 percentage points (pp). However, RT-DETR CER results are significantly higher when the models are trained with NorHand-331861 and Nuremberg LB 3 indicating it is unsuitable even for the in-domain setting.
blocks.zh: 对于域内案例,当模型通过从同一份文件收集中分出测试来进行训练和测试时,CER结果(表3荫影)非常接近基线,Hi-SAM和YOLO的文本行框给出了最大相差0.56个百分点(pp). 然而,如果使用NorHand-331861和纽伦堡LB 3对模型进行培训,RT-DETR核证排减量的结果要高得多,因为即便在域内设置也不合适。

blocks.en:
The CER values for the out-of-domain evaluation setting, where the line detector models are trained on one dataset and tested on the remaining datasets, are presented in Table 3 (not shaded). Additionally, the last column reports the average CER gap between the OOD predictions and the GT baseline. When Hi-SAM is trained on NorHand-331861, READ 2016, Nuremberg LB 3, or the Mix dataset and evaluated on out-of-domain datasets, the average CER gaps relative to the baseline are 5.09pp, 3.57pp, 5.27pp and 2.90pp, respectively.
The OOD YOLO average CER gaps are 9.65pp, 19.99pp, 14.85pp and 4.36pp, respectively.
The RT-DETR reported the highest OOD average CER gaps with 54.40pp, 17.71pp, 55.05pp and 27.41pp, thus indicating poor generalizability.
blocks.zh:
表3(不是阴影)列出了域外评价设置的CER值,即线上探测器模型在一个数据集上接受培训并测试其余数据集。 此外,上一栏报告了OD预测与GT基线之间的平均CER差距。 当Hi-SAM在NorHand-331861,READ 2016,纽伦堡LB 3或Mix数据集上接受训练并在域外数据集上评价时,CER相对于基线的平均差距分别为5.09pp,3.57pp,5.27pp和2.90pp.
OOD YOLO的平均CER差距分别为9.65pp, 19.99pp, 14.85pp和 4.36pp.
RT-DETR报告的OD平均CER差距最大,分别为54.40pp、17.71pp、55.05pp和27.41pp,这表明通用性差。

blocks.en: We observed that when YOLO is trained on the Mix dataset, the gap between the baseline CER and the CER obtained from predicted line boxes is substantially reduced. In this setting, the OOD average CER gap is 4.36pp which is now highly competitive with Hi-SAM. This suggests that, compared with Hi-SAM, YOLO benefits more from diverse and generalizable training data.
blocks.zh: 我们注意到,当YOLO接受混合数据集培训时,基线CER与从预测的行框中获得的CER之间的差距被大大缩小了。 在此情况下,OOD平均CER差距为4.36pp,目前与Hi-SAM竞争激烈. 这表明,与Hi-SAM相比,YOLO更多地受益于多样而通俗的培训数据。

blocks.en: 4.5 Impact of Few-shot Learning
blocks.zh: 4.5 少见学习的影响

blocks.en: We observed the strongest generalizability when the models were trained on the Mix dataset, especially Hi-SAM and YOLO. In this section, we fine-tune them using 10 and 50 target-domain few-shot sample pages to evaluate whether limited in-domain supervision can further improve line detector performance. Given its comparatively poor performance across the zero-shot evaluations, RT-DETR was excluded from the few-shot fine-tuning stage.
blocks.zh: 我们在Mix数据集,特别是Hi-SAM和YOLO的模型培训时观察到最强的通性. 在本节中,我们利用10和50个目标域数发样本页对其进行微调,以评价有限的域内监管能否进一步提高线上探测器的性能. RT-DETR在零发评价中的表现相对不佳,因此被排除在几发微调阶段之外。

blocks.en: Table 4: Few-shot mAP% evaluation of Hi-SAM and YOLO line detectors pre-trained on the Mix dataset and fine-tuned on six target datasets. Zero-shot rows report the corresponding results from Table 2 . Higher values indicate better performance.
blocks.zh: 表4:对Mix数据集预训的Hi-SAM和YOLO线探测器进行微分mAP%评价,并微调了6个目标数据集. 零射出行报告表2的相应结果. 较高的数值表明表现较好。

blocks.en: As shown in Table 4 , both Hi-SAM and YOLO achieve substantial mAP improvements when fine-tuned with even just 10 few-shot samples from the out-of-domain target datasets. Increasing the few-shot set from 10 to 50 samples provides additional gains, but they appear smaller considering the additional 40 pages of zoning an archive would have to complete on the target domain. This suggests the sufficiency of 10 few-shot samples.
blocks.zh: 如表4所显示的,Hi-SAM和YOLO在对来自域外目标数据集的10个几发样本进行微调后,都实现了大幅的mAP改进. 将几发样本从10个增加到50个可带来额外收益,但考虑到一个档案必须完成目标域的40页分区,这些样本似乎较小。 这表明10个几发样本已经足够。

blocks.en: Table 5: Few-shot CER% evaluation of line detectors pre-trained on the Mix dataset and fine-tuned on six OOD datasets. Zero-shot rows report the corresponding results from Table 3 . Lower values indicate better performance. The GT row reports the performance of the HTR model when trained using ground-truth line bounding boxes.
blocks.zh: 表5:对Mix数据集预先培训的线上探测器进行几发CER%评价,并对6个OOD数据集进行微调. 零射出行报告表3的相应结果. 数值较低表明业绩较好。 GT行在使用地-真线相接框进行训练时报告HTR模型的性能.

blocks.en:
Fine-tuning on the target datasets reduces the CER gap relative to the baseline, as shown in Table 5 . For Hi-SAM, the average gap decreases from 2.90pp to 1.69pp with target-domain fine-tuning with 10 samples. Increasing the few-shot set to 50 samples provides only a marginal improvement, reducing the average gap to 1.19pp.
YOLO, on the other hand, is more sensitive to few-shot fine-tuning. In the most extreme case, when fine-tuned on NorHand-72702, the CER decreases from 10.81% to 3.08% using only 10 few-shot samples. On average, using 10 few-shot samples reduces the CER gap between the baseline and prediction-based results to 2.04pp. Increasing the number of samples to 50 further reduces the gap to 1.42pp, showing a similar diminishing-return pattern to that observed for Hi-SAM.
blocks.zh:
如表5所示,对目标数据集进行精细调整可缩小核证的排减量相对于基准的差距。 对Hi-SAM来说,平均差距从2.90pp降至1.69pp,目标域微调为10个样本. 将几发相集增加到50个样本只能提供微小的改进,将平均差距缩小到1.19pp.
而YOLO则对几发微调较为敏感. 在最极端的情况下,在NorHand-72702上进行微调时,使用10个几发样本的CER从10.81%下降到3.08%. 平均而言,使用10个几发样本将基准结果与以预测为基础的结果之间的CER差距减少到2.04pp. 将样本数量增加到50个进一步将差距缩小到1.42pp,显示出与Hi-SAM观测到的相似的回落模式.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: We observed that Hi-SAM generalizes well across the out-of-domain target datasets, regardless of the dataset used for training. In contrast, YOLO shows limited generalization when trained on a single dataset. However, training YOLO on the Mix dataset substantially improves its cross-domain performance by introducing greater domain diversity during training. When the Mix-trained YOLO model is further fine-tuned with only 10 target-domain samples, its performance becomes marginally closer to that of Hi-SAM.
blocks.zh: 我们注意到,无论培训所用的数据集如何,Hi-SAM在域外目标数据集中都得到了很好的概括。 相形之下,YOLO在单一数据集培训时显示的概括性有限. 然而,对YOLO进行关于Mix数据集的培训,在培训期间引入了更大的领域多样性,从而大大提高了其跨领域绩效。 当Mix-trained YOLO模型被进一步微调,只有10个目标域样本时,其性能会变得与Hi-SAM稍相接近.

blocks.en: 5.1 Generalization Capabilities
blocks.zh: 5.1 通用能力

blocks.en: In terms of pure generalization, i.e. training on one dataset and then making predictions on various others, the Hi-SAM model demonstrates remarkable ability. As illustrated qualitatively in Figure 2 , Hi-SAM reliably recognizes complete lines, even in visually different domains. Although the predicted text line regions are somewhat more extensive than the corresponding ground-truth on which our HTR models were trained, Hi-SAM’s recognition results are significantly better.
blocks.zh: 在纯泛化方面,即培训一个数据集,然后对各种其他数据集进行预测,Hi-SAM模型显示出了卓越的能力。 如图2所示,Hi-SAM可靠地识别出完整的行,即使在视线不同的领域也是如此。 虽然预测的文本行区域比我们HTR模型所训练的对应地面真相要广泛一些,但Hi-SAM的识别结果要好得多。

blocks.en: On the other hand, both YOLO and RT-DETR exhibit noticeable difficulties with direct zero-shot generalization. For example, YOLO has difficulty capturing complete lines of text, so only sections are often detected. This occurs despite the use of appropriate data augmentation, which presents the network with lines of text spanning the entire width of the input image. Variations in the structure and color of the substrate also hinder recognition. RT-DETR typically recognizes the full line of text but often skips entire lines and paragraphs.
blocks.zh: 另一方面,YOLO和RT-DETR在直接零发通化方面都显示出明显的困难。 例如,YOLO很难捕捉完整行的文字,所以只有段落经常被检测出. 尽管使用了适当的数据扩充,使网络具有横跨输入图像整个宽度的文字线,但还是发生了这种情况。 基底的结构和颜色的变化也阻碍了识别. RT-DETR通常会识别出整行文字,但往往会跳过整行和段落.

blocks.en: 5.2 mAP vs CER as Evaluation Metric
blocks.zh: 5.2 mAP vs CER 作为评价计量

blocks.en: These results further highlight the importance of using an appropriate metric to evaluate prediction quality. As discussed in more detail in Section 4.3 , it is crucial for downstream text recognition that the text is captured in its entirety, even if the bounding box noticeably exceeds the ground-truth box. Hi-SAM’s results demonstrate this. Its mAP scores indicate segmentation results comparable to those of a YOLO model. However, a qualitative assessment and subsequent CER analysis show that Hi-SAM’s boxes are significantly better suited for text recognition because they capture the full text. YOLO and RT-DETR fail to recognize substantial portions of the document.
blocks.zh: 这些结果进一步突出了使用适当衡量标准评估预测质量的重要性。 正如第4.3节所更详细地讨论的那样,必须承认下游案文是完整地记录下来的,即使捆绑的盒子明显地超过地面真实的盒子。 Hi-SAM的结果显示这一点。 其mAP分数表示分化结果可与YOLO模型相媲美. 然而,定性评估和随后的CER分析表明,Hi-SAM的盒子更适合文本识别,因为它们能捕捉到全文. YOLO和RT-DETR没有认识到文件的大部分内容。

blocks.en: 5.3 Fine-tuning Impact
blocks.zh: 5.3 微调影响

blocks.en: Our primary interest in fine-tuning was focusing on whether the YOLO model, which is significantly smaller and thus faster, could catch up to Hi-SAM’s performance with a relatively small amount of additional training data, despite lagging behind Hi-SAM in terms of zero-shot generalization.
blocks.zh: 我们对微调的主要兴趣在于YOLO模型(这个模型规模小得多,因此速度快)能否以相对较少的额外培训数据赶上Hi-SAM的性能,尽管在零射通则方面落后于Hi-SAM.

blocks.en: The results suggest that it can. Even with rather low-cost annotation of just ten pages from the desired target dataset, results can match the zero-shot performance of Hi-SAM. Specifically, as shown in Table 5 , the average CER deviation from the ground-truth baseline is reduced from 4.36pp to 2.04pp with just ten annotated pages and to 1.42pp with 50 pages. Hi-SAM continues to achieve better results with 10 (1.69pp) and 50 (1.19pp) pages of fine-tuning but does so at significantly higher training costs. The qualitative improvement over the zero-shot generalization result is also less pronounced.
blocks.zh: 结果表明它可以。 即使从理想的目标数据集中只给出了10页的相当低成本的注释,结果也能与Hi-SAM的零发性能相匹配. 具体地说,如表5所显示的,核证排减量与地面实况基线的平均偏差从4.36pp减少到2.04pp,只有10页注解,再减少到1.42pp,有50页。 Hi-SAM以10页(1.69pp)和50页(1.19pp)的微调继续取得更好的成果,但这样做的训练费用却大大增加。 与零射通化结果相比,质量改善也不太明显。

blocks.en: For a direct comparison, we also initialized a YOLO model with standard COCO pre-training and trained it on the 10- and 50-shot pages, presented in the last two rows of Table 5 . With only ten pages, YOLO’s results are noticeably unstable and fail to produce usable results for some datasets. However, when there is sufficient training data available, competitive performance can even be achieved without pre-training on other historical documents.
blocks.zh: 为了进行直接比较,我们还在标准COCO预训中初始化了YOLO模型,并在表5最后两行的10和50相的页面上对其进行了培训。 YOLO只有10页,结果明显不稳定,无法对某些数据集产生可用结果。 然而,如果有足够的培训数据,甚至可以在不对其他历史文件进行预先培训的情况下实现竞争性业绩。

blocks.en: 5.4 Resource Requirements
blocks.zh: 5.4 所需资源

blocks.en: Apart from segmentation performance, size is one of the most significant differences between the Hi-SAM and YOLO models. Hi-SAM is far more complex in memory size and number of parameters and thus challenging to train. Nevertheless, Hi-SAM delivers a greater generalization capability than the other models.
blocks.zh: 除了分解性能,尺寸是Hi-SAM和YOLO模型之间最显著的区别之一. Hi-SAM在内存大小和参数数量上要复杂得多,因此对训练具有挑战性. 尽管如此,相较于其他模型,Hi-SAM提供更大的通缩能力.

blocks.en: Table 6: Overview of run times of the tested models in different use case environments, investigating the loading time for models as well as training and inference performance.
blocks.zh: 表6:不同使用环境中被测试模型运行时间概述,调查模型的装载时间以及培训和推断性能.

blocks.en: Table 6 compares training and inference performance of three different computational scenarios: a high-performance cluster designed for machine learning tasks with A100 GPU nodes available, a desktop computer with a dedicated graphics card (AMD Ryzen 9 7950X3D @ 4.20 GHz, GeForce RTX 4080, 64 GB DDR5-RAM), and a laptop without a dedicated graphics card (Intel Core Ultra 7 155 U @ 4.8 GHz, 64 GB DDR5-RAM). In all cases we trained the models on the 350 pages of the READ training set, and we computed the inference on the 50 pages in the READ test set before dividing by the number of pages.
blocks.zh: 表6比较了三种不同计算情景的培训和推论性能:为机器学习任务设计的具有A100 GPU节点的高性能集群,具有专用图形卡的台式计算机(AMD Ryzen 9 7950X3D @ 4.20 GHz,GeForce RTX 4080,64 GB DDR5-RAM)和没有专用图形卡的笔记本电脑(Intel Core Ultra 7 155 U@ 4.8 GHz,64 GB DDR5-RAM). 在所有情况下,我们培训了350页的READ训练集模型,我们计算了在READ测试集中50页的推论,然后除以页数。

blocks.en: Hi-SAM requires substantially more computational resources than the other models. Initializing Hi-SAM with pre-trained weights reduces the training cost by nearly half while maintaining similar generalization performance (see Supplementary Material). In resource-constrained settings, particularly with limited GPU availability, YOLO provides a competitive alternative, achieving strong results when trained on the Mix dataset and fine-tuned with only 10 target-domain pages.
blocks.zh: 相较于其他模型,Hi-SAM需要大量的计算资源. 初始化的Hi-SAM采用前所训练的权重将培训费用降低近一半,同时保持类似的通缩性能(见"补充材料"). 在资源受限的设置中,特别是在有限的GPU可用性下,YOLO提供了一个竞争性的替代方案,在Mix数据集的培训中,并在只有10个目标域页面的微调下,取得了强劲的成果.

blocks.en: As expected, a dedicated graphics card greatly impacts training and inference times. Therefore, purchasing an older graphics card can be useful when dealing with large document collections. However, it is unclear whether the time investment required to train a specialized YOLO model is always worthwhile. Given Hi-SAM’s strong generalization results, testing the pretrained Hi-SAM model on your dataset before investing more time in creating training data and fine-tuning seems like a reasonable alternative.
blocks.zh: 如所料,专用图形卡对培训和推断时间有很大影响。 因此,购买更古老的图形卡在处理大型文件收藏时可能有用. 然而,目前还不清楚培训专门的YOLO模式所需的时间投资是否总是值得的。 鉴于 Hi-SAM的强通化结果,在您数据集上测试预先训练的Hi-SAM模型,然后投入更多时间来创建培训数据和微调,这似乎是一个合理的选择.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: Our experimental study shows that text line segmentation does not require extensive collection of new training data for each new dataset.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验研究表明,文本行分割不需要为每个新的数据集广泛收集新的培训数据。

blocks.en: The complex yet highly capable Hi-SAM model, in particular, has demonstrated that it can reliably localize text lines across a wide range of potential target domains with highly varied visual layouts, even when trained on a single initial dataset. This makes Hi-SAM a promising zero-shot foundation model for previously untapped datasets, enabling the direct extraction of text lines from document pages.
blocks.zh: 特别是复杂而能力很强的Hi-SAM模型已经表明,它能够可靠地将文字行定位于各种潜在目标域,其视觉布局差异很大,即便在单一初始数据集上受过培训。 这使得Hi-SAM成为以前未开发数据集的有希望的零镜头基础模型,从而能够从文档页面直接取出文本行.

blocks.en: Our fine-tuning experiments have also shown that simpler, smaller models, such as YOLO, can be trained to specialize in a specific dataset using affordable hardware architectures and achieve competitive results with only a small amount of annotated data. As few as ten pages are sufficient to fine-tune a model to the characteristics of a given dataset.
blocks.zh: 我们的微调实验也表明,YOLO等更简单更小的模型可以被训练出专门使用可负担的硬件架构进行特定的数据集,并以少量附加说明的数据来达到竞争效果. 多达10页足以使一个模型对特定数据集的特点进行微调。

blocks.en: The experiments conducted here have primarily focused on documents with a rather simple layout: single-column text arranged in neat horizontal lines with minimal marginalia. Detecting and recognizing more complex layouts, such as those with curved or rotated text lines or tabular structures, increases the complexity of the problem. This issue will be examined in greater detail in future research.
blocks.zh: 这里进行的实验主要集中于布局相当简单的文件:单列文字排列成整齐的横向行并最小边缘. 检测和识别更复杂的布局,如有曲线或旋转的文本行或表格结构的布局,会增加问题的复杂性. 这个问题将在今后的研究中得到更详尽的审查。

blocks.en: In this study we focused on the generalization capabilities of text line segmentation models. However, these models constitute only the first step in an HTR pipeline. Therefore, further research to investigate and develop domain adaptation and generalization for HTR models to determine and reduce the effort required for data acquisition in this context is also needed.
blocks.zh: 在这项研究中,我们侧重于文本行分割模型的通缩能力. 然而,这些模型只是HTR管道的第一步。 因此,还需要作进一步研究,调查和开发HTR模型的域调整和概括,以确定和减少在这方面收集数据所需的努力。
